items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The way you put it at the time was that you liked Dustin Hoffman vis-a-vis Robert DeNiro. Both great actors, but Robert DiNiro is Robert DiNiro, and Dustin Hoffman... Is everybody. Yeah.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah? Well, again, I’m pretty sociable and open about people expressing themselves, including writers and critics, and whoever wants to speak about music should to speak about music in the terms that they want. So I thought it was kind of a cute term, “chameleon.”
